zh: 给你一条价格路径。每一步你决定持有多少仓位，净值跟着价格涨跌。和基准（一般是买入持有）在同一批路径上比，按三种口径衡量：长期增长率、夏普比率、带风险上限的期望收益。
en: You are given a price path. At each step you decide how large a position to hold, and your wealth rises and falls with the price. You are compared with the benchmark (usually buy and hold) on the same batch of paths, and measured by three criteria: long-run growth rate, Sharpe ratio, and expected return with a risk cap.

en: You have now looked at this out-of-sample data §0§ times. Each time you look and then go back to tune the parameters, it becomes a little less "out-of-sample": pick the best of §1§ unrelated alternatives and, even if they are all noise, the best one will lead by about §2§ standard errors.

zh: 滚动窗口互相重叠，上面的标准误偏小，只能当作下限。

en: The numbers above come from the training segment. Look at the out-of-sample result only after you have finished tuning the parameters, and try to look only once.

zh: 上面的数字来自你正在调参的这批路径。新路径是从同一段历史里重新抽出来的：它检验的是抽样的运气，不是这段历史本身；后者要换到"真实数据"世界去揭晓样本外。
en: The numbers above come from the batch of paths you are tuning on. The fresh paths are resampled from the same stretch of history: this tests the luck of the sampling, not this stretch of history itself; to test the latter, switch to the "Real data" world and reveal the out-of-sample result.

zh: 上面的数字来自你正在调参的这批路径。新路径随时可以再生成，所以这里的检验是干净的。
en: The numbers above come from the batch of paths you are tuning on. Fresh paths can be generated at any time, so the test here is clean.

zh: 有 §0§ 的步数里规则返回了无效值（NaN），按空仓处理。若不是预热期造成的，请检查代码。
en: In §0§ of the steps the rule returned an invalid value (NaN), which is treated as flat. If this is not caused by the warm-up period, check the code.

zh: 只有一条历史路径：没有分布，标准误来自时间序列本身，夏普的标准误约为 1/√年数。想看分布可以改用"滚动窗口"或 bootstrap 世界。
en: There is only one historical path: there is no distribution, the standard errors come from the time series itself, and the standard error of the Sharpe ratio is about 1/√(number of years). To see a distribution, switch to "Rolling windows" or to the bootstrap world.

zh: 滚动窗口互相重叠，标准误偏小。
en: The rolling windows overlap, so the standard errors are too small.

zh: 这条规则要先训练模型：训练段的前 §0§%（§1§ 步）留给模型学，上面的结果和图表只来自后面的 §2§ 步。不带训练的规则用的是整个训练段，两者的数字不能直接比；放进"多策略对比"里会自动对齐到同一段。
en: This rule has to train a model first: the first §0§% of the training segment (§1§ steps) is set aside for the model to learn from, and the results and charts above come only from the §2§ steps after it. Rules without training use the whole training segment, so the two sets of numbers cannot be compared directly; in "Strategy comparison" they are aligned to the same segment automatically.

zh: 差别小于这里显示的精度
en: The difference is smaller than the precision shown here

en: The score above comes from the batch of episodes you are tuning the parameters on. Once the parameters are tuned, play again on a fresh batch the rule has not seen: if the score drops a lot, the parameters have merely adapted to the luck of this batch.

zh: 有 §0§ 的回合里规则返回了无效值（不是数，或者 NaN），裁判按"什么都不做"处理。请检查代码。

zh: 这条规则在这一批对局里从头到尾没有开过仓。常见的原因：它要回看的步数比一局还长（这里一局只有 §0§ §1§）。把它的窗口调短，或者把这一局调长。
en: This rule never opened a position at any point in this batch of episodes. A common cause: it looks back over more steps than an episode has (here an episode has only §0§ §1§s). Shorten its window, or make the episode longer.

zh: function decide(s, p, st, model)   必须。每一步调用一次，返回目标仓位 f
en: function decide(s, p, st, model)   Required. Called once per step; returns the target position f

zh: function init(p, model)            可选。每条路径开始时调用，返回这条路径自己的状态 st
en: function init(p, model)            Optional. Called at the start of each path; returns that path's own state st

zh: function fit(D, p, ml, rng)        可选。回测前调用一次，在专门留给模型的数据 D 上训练，返回 model
en: function fit(D, p, ml, rng)        Optional. Called once before the backtest; trains on the data D set aside for the model and returns model

zh: f = 资产市值 / 净值：1 满仓，0 空仓，负数做空，大于 1 加杠杆。返回 NaN 视为空仓。
en: f = market value of the asset / wealth: 1 is fully invested, 0 is flat, negative is short, above 1 is leveraged. Returning NaN is treated as flat.

zh: s.t  s.T  s.K        当前步、总步数、每年步数
en: s.t  s.T  s.K        Current step, total number of steps, steps per year

zh: s.price  s.logp      当前价格及其对数
en: s.price  s.logp      Current price and its logarithm

zh: s.wealth  s.pos      当前净值（初始为 1）、当前仓位
en: s.wealth  s.pos      Current wealth (initially 1), current position

zh: s.rf                 每步的无风险利率（交易设定里的年利率 ÷ 每年步数）；按超额收益下注时要减掉它
en: s.rf                 Risk-free rate per step (the annual rate in the trading settings ÷ steps per year); subtract it when betting on excess returns

zh: s.ret(k)             最近第 k 个单步收益（k=0 是刚实现的一步）
en: s.ret(k)             The k-th most recent one-step return (k=0 is the step just realized)

zh: s.mom(n)             过去 n 步的累计收益
en: s.mom(n)             Cumulative return over the past n steps

zh: s.sma(n)  s.psd(n)   最近 n 个价格的均值、标准差
en: s.sma(n)  s.psd(n)   Mean and standard deviation of the last n prices

zh: s.z(n)               (价格 − 均线) / 标准差
s.mean(n)  s.vol(n)  最近 n 个单步收益的均值、标准差（每步）
en: s.mean(n)  s.vol(n)  Mean and standard deviation of the last n one-step returns (per step)

zh: s.hi(n)  s.lo(n)     最近 n 个价格的最高、最低
en: s.hi(n)  s.lo(n)     Highest and lowest of the last n prices

zh: s.rets(n)  s.prices(n)  最近 n 个收益 / 价格组成的数组（旧的在前）
en: s.rets(n)  s.prices(n)  Array of the last n returns / prices (oldest first)

zh: 数据不够时，上面返回单个数的函数给出 NaN，s.rets / s.prices 给出较短的数组。规则只能看到当前步及以前的数据。
en: When there is not enough data, the functions above that return a single number give NaN, and s.rets / s.prices give a shorter array. A rule can only see data up to and including the current step.

zh: function decide(s, p, st, model)   必须。每回合调用一次，返回这一回合的动作（一个数，含义见下）
en: function decide(s, p, st, model)   Required. Called once per round; returns the action for that round (a number; its meaning is given below)

zh: function init(p, model)            可选。每一局开始时调用，返回这一局自己的状态 st
en: function init(p, model)            Optional. Called at the start of each episode; returns that episode's own state st

zh: function fit(D, p, ml, rng)        可选。计分之前调用一次，在另外一批对局 D 上先算好要用的东西，返回 model
en: function fit(D, p, ml, rng)        Optional. Called once before scoring; precomputes what it needs on a separate batch of episodes D and returns model

zh: s.t  s.T             现在是第几回合（从 0 数起）、一局共几回合
en: s.t  s.T             Index of the current round (counting from 0), number of rounds in an episode

zh: s.g                  这套玩法的常数（见下）；fit 里是 D.g
en: s.g                  This game's constants (see below); in fit it is D.g

zh: 返回值不是数，或者是 NaN：记为无效动作，裁判按"什么都不做"处理。规则只能看到当前回合及以前的信息。
en: If the return value is not a number, or is NaN, it is recorded as an invalid action and the referee treats it as "do nothing". A rule can only see information up to and including the current round.

zh: fit(D, p, ml, rng) 在回测前调用一次；返回的对象会作为 model 传给 init 和 decide。
en: fit(D, p, ml, rng) is called once before the backtest; the object it returns is passed to init and decide as model.

zh: D 是专门留给模型的数据，回测用的数据 fit 看不到：模拟的世界里是另外生成的一批路径；真实数据里是训练段的前 60%，只有一条路径（D.N = 1）。
en: D is data set aside for the model, and fit cannot see the data used in the backtest: in a simulated world D is a separately generated batch of paths; with real data it is the first 60% of the training segment, with only one path (D.N = 1).

zh: D.N 路径数，D.T 步数，D.K；D.at(n, t) 返回第 n 条路径第 t 步的 s（与 decide 里的 s 一样用）；
en: D.N number of paths, D.T number of steps, D.K; D.at(n, t) returns the s at step t of path n (used the same way as the s in decide);

zh: D.next(n, t) 是第 t→t+1 步资产的收益；D.fwd(n, t, h) 是未来 h 步的累计收益。
en: D.next(n, t) is the asset's return over step t→t+1; D.fwd(n, t, h) is the cumulative return over the next h steps.

zh: feat(s) 返回特征数组，含 NaN 的行、长度不足的行（预热期）自动丢弃；目标默认是下一步收益；from/to 限定路径范围、t0/t1 限定时刻范围（切训练/验证用）。
en: feat(s) returns the feature array; rows containing NaN and rows that are too short (warm-up period) are dropped automatically; the default target is the next-step return; from/to restrict the range of paths and t0/t1 the range of time steps (for splitting training/validation).

zh: 训练集为空时各个模型会直接报错：先检查 ds.n，样本太少就 throw new Error(说明原因)。
en: When the training set is empty, every model throws an error straight away: check ds.n first, and if there are too few samples, throw new Error(stating the reason).

zh: 模型（都返回带 predict(x) 的对象，x 是特征数组）：
en: Models (each returns an object with predict(x), where x is a feature array):

zh: ml.ols(ds)   ml.ridge(ds, lambda)   ml.lasso(ds, alpha)   ml.logistic(ds, {l2})（y 取 0/1，predict 给概率）
en: ml.ols(ds)   ml.ridge(ds, lambda)   ml.lasso(ds, alpha)   ml.logistic(ds, {l2}) (y takes the values 0/1; predict gives a probability)

zh: ml.hmm(seqs, {states, iters}) → {mu, sd, A, stationary, filter()}；filter() 返回在线滤波器：update(r)、p、mean()、variance()
en: ml.hmm(seqs, {states, iters}) → {mu, sd, A, stationary, filter()}; filter() returns an online filter: update(r), p, mean(), variance()

zh: ml.kalman({q, r}) → 在线滤波器，update(y) 返回滤波后的均值
en: ml.kalman({q, r}) → an online filter; update(y) returns the filtered mean

zh: 工具：ml.mean(a)  ml.variance(a)  ml.metrics(pred, y) → {r2, ic, hit, mse}  ml.predictAll(model, ds)  ml.table(rows, ys)
en: Utilities: ml.mean(a)  ml.variance(a)  ml.metrics(pred, y) → {r2, ic, hit, mse}  ml.predictAll(model, ds)  ml.table(rows, ys)

zh: ml.diagnose(model, trainDs, validDs, featureNames) → 诊断报告。把它放进返回对象的 diag 字段，实验室会画出"学到的函数""模型诊断""特征重要性"三张图；
en: ml.diagnose(model, trainDs, validDs, featureNames) → a diagnostic report. Put it in the diag field of the returned object and the lab will draw three charts: "Learned function", "Model diagnostics", and "Feature importance";

zh: 返回对象的 note 字段（字符串）会显示在规则下方。
en: the note field (a string) of the returned object is shown below the rule.

zh: fit 的计算量控制在几秒以内：maxRows 一般取 1–2 万。
en: Keep fit's computation within a few seconds: maxRows is typically 10,000–20,000.
